description:
## [1.7.1](https://github.com/DrBushyTop/relay-morphe-patches/compare/v1.7.0...v1.7.1) (2026-11-22)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* Keep playing videos and GIFs from holding the top refresh rate ([832fdab](https://github.com/DrBushyTop/relay-morphe-patches/commit/832fdab796868a0e13a925ed8707b3c2a33de61b))

patches.name: Fix GIF sound
patches.description: Plays GIF videos from the site that hosts them, with sound, instead of Reddit's silent copy. When the original can't be loaded, Reddit's copy plays as before.

patches.name: Fix video crashes
patches.description: Stops Relay from crashing on a post whose video has no URL (when the post's More menu opens, for one) and when the video controls button is tapped before a video loads.

patches.name: Night theme like OLED, grey in dim light
patches.description: Makes the Night theme look like Night (OLED), except at very low brightness, where its blacks turn dark grey. For vivo phones with an adaptive refresh rate: they hold a mostly black screen at 60 Hz in dim light, which uses more battery than the grey. Night (OLED) is not changed.

patches.name: Open Reddit images in the image viewer
patches.description: Opens i.redd.it and preview.redd.it images (.jpeg, .webp, ...) in Relay's image viewer. Relay only recognised .jpg and .png, so these went to the browser, which Reddit now redirects to the comment thread. Also plays Reddit's MP4 copies of GIFs in Relay's video player.

patches.name: Prefer high refresh rate
patches.description: Asks for the display's highest refresh rate while Relay is scrolling or animating after a touch, so scrolling is not held at 60 Hz on adaptive refresh rate phones. The request is dropped once the screen is still, and videos and GIFs playing on their own don't hold it, so the phone can lower the rate for them.

patches.name: Reject ad consent
patches.description: Answers Relay's ad consent request (Google's cookie and personal data form) with "reject all" without showing it: no purposes, no vendors, no legitimate interest. An answer given before is replaced.

patches.name: Restore random subreddits
patches.description: Makes the Random Subreddit and RandomNSFW Subreddit menu items work again. Reddit removed r/random and r/randnsfw, so Relay now picks one itself: Random from Reddit's popular subreddits, RandomNSFW from a list of NSFW subreddits bundled with the patch. Refresh picks another one, as before.

patches.name: Show comment images inline
patches.description: Draws pictures and GIFs linked in a comment (Reddit uploads, Giphy, i.imgur) inside the comment instead of as a link. Tapping one opens it full screen as before. GIFs animate on Wi-Fi and show a still on mobile data. Follows Relay's NSFW Thumbnails setting. Can be turned off, or limited to Wi-Fi, in Settings > Behaviour > Comments.
